rules: Top 3 in the Atlantic or a wild card

headings.leadersBlurb: These two lead the East divisions. Everyone else is chasing the other six berths.
headings.pathsBlurb: Finish top three in the Atlantic, or be one of the two best remaining teams in the East.
headings.footer: Updated from the NHL’s public API. Not affiliated with the NHL or the Red Wings.
headings.footerTiny: Eight teams in the conference qualify: the top three in each division and two wild cards. A regulation win and an overtime win are both two points. The playoff percentage is a season simulation from points percentage and home ice. It is not a betting line.
headings.conclusion: The Detroit Red Wings have been mathematically eliminated from the Stanley Cup playoffs.
headings.rootingBlurb: Win odds use the same points model as the playoff card. Not a betting line, and not a live in-game number.

narrative.headline: In the field
narrative.blurb: The Red Wings are in through the East wild card. The cushion is In. Every remaining point is about staying there.

playoffOdds.note: Each remaining game is simulated from points percentage, shrunk toward .500, with a home-ice bump. About 23% of games go past regulation and give the loser a point. Not a betting line.
